categories.main_business_segments: System Research Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the software-related business, with its main activities divided into SI (System Integration) services, software development, software product development and sales, IT equipment sales, and other services such as web site operation and cloud (SaaS) offerings. The company and its consolidated subsidiary, Soel Co., Ltd., focus on providing comprehensive IT solutions, including system proposal, development, and maintenance for a wide range of industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages expertise in system integration, software engineering, and advanced IT solutions, including POS management systems with electronic payment, factory automation (FA) control technologies, warehouse management/control systems (WMS/WCS), and development environments for PLCs. It employs both waterfall and agile methodologies, with a focus on quality management (ISO9001), legacy system migration, and cloud-based platforms. The company also develops proprietary SaaS products and utilizes AI and RPA technologies for digital transformation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: System Research serves a diverse customer base, with a strong focus on large enterprises, especially in manufacturing (notably the Toyota Group and automotive sector), distribution, and service industries. Its end markets include companies seeking custom enterprise systems, SMEs needing packaged software, and organizations requiring IT infrastructure and digital transformation support.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are concentrated in Japan, with headquarters in Nagoya and major offices in Tokyo and Osaka. All sales and assets are domestic, with no significant overseas operations or customers reported.
categories.supply_chain_position: System Research operates primarily as a midstream and downstream IT service provider, acting as a prime contractor (prime vendor) for end-users and also collaborating with manufacturers and other SIers. It delivers both custom solutions and packaged products directly to clients, and occasionally procures hardware and software from upstream suppliers for resale.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include expanding its solution business, increasing prime vendor contracts, growing recurring (stock) business, and strengthening its position in digital transformation (DX) services. R&D focuses on AI-driven solutions (e.g., AI-FAQ for call centers), SaaS product development, and DX technologies such as cloud, RPA, and low-code platforms. Human resource development, sustainability (ESG/SDGs), and internal DX are also emphasized.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through project-based system integration contracts (fixed-price and time-and-materials), ongoing maintenance and support, packaged software sales (including licensing and maintenance), IT equipment sales, and recurring SaaS/cloud service subscriptions. The company also earns revenue from web-based services and payment solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: System Research is positioned as an independent (non-affiliated) SIer, competing with both independent and user-affiliated SI companies as well as IT subsidiaries of manufacturers. Its main competitors include other mid-sized Japanese SIers and IT service providers. The company differentiates itself through its independence, technical expertise, and strong relationships with major clients like Toyota.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated net sales were ¥25.93 billion (approx. $170 million), with operating profit of ¥2.99 billion and net profit attributable to shareholders of ¥2.19 billion. The company has demonstrated steady growth, with sales increasing by over 10% annually in recent years, and targets even higher growth rates (15%) and profitability (15% operating margin) in its mid-term vision. It employs approximately 1,484 people.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: System Research emphasizes its independence from hardware vendors, allowing it to provide optimal, unbiased IT solutions tailored to client needs. Its strengths include deep technical expertise, comprehensive service from planning to maintenance, high quality standards (ISO9001), and the ability to address complex, industry-specific challenges. The company also highlights its proprietary SaaS products, DX capabilities, and strong, trust-based relationships with major clients.
